The ladder: STAND DOWN (nothing) → WATCH (1-2 on alert) → SETUP (aligning) → ACT (3 signals confirmed 3 sessions across 3 different families). The two sides count only confirmed signals (the buffer that filters one-day pops), grouped by family so three SKEW cousins never count as three. Rejected and checklist rows are excluded.
How to read each row: the bar shows how far this divergence has developed toward the level that fires the signal, 0% = a normal market, 100% = the alert level is reached. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = the divergence is forming, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro. Grey rows are conditions Kerberos tracked that we cannot source yet; they stay listed so the catalog remains complete. Our own backtest verdicts live inside each row's detail.
